ls_top.why: Binance's API rounds this ratio to 4 decimals; the archive keeps more (largest gap 0.00005).

ls_accounts.why: The API's ratio is its long share / short share, each already rounded to 4 decimals (checked: 0.7444 / 0.2556 = 2.9124); the archive divides the unrounded shares.

taker_ls.why: Same 5-minute row (checked by hand), but Binance's API and archive differ by about 0.1%, beyond rounding. Their volume figures differ slightly; nothing on our side can remove it.
